observations.finding: The angular fluorescent source crown becomes a coherent softly rounded golden wrap with a diagonal folded upper mass, continuous rolled bands and a compact side knot. Front, profiles and rear have real depth and related construction. Fold shading remains visible without blown-white top planes; broad quiet cloth regions are intentional volume, not unlit dead spots.

Ama remains dark-brown with a short dark-brown fringe, golden-yellow headwrap, ivory coat, green apron AND green necktie, and dark shoes. The new brown/green/ivory separation is warm and restrained, and avoids the target lighter orange skin drift. The face remains friendly with readable eyes, brows, small nose, cheeks and smile at intended logical size.

The ivory tunic and rolled cuffs replace harsh source sleeve facets with comfortable rounded volumes. Green bib straps with small warm fasteners, collar/tie layering, a raised rounded pocket edge, hem/waist structure and a small rear bow give the outfit purposeful construction. These forms remain legible at logical192x320. The retained compact apron and short legs fit the source game scale.

Both true profiles and the rear are coherent continuations of the same hair, wrap and garments. The small exposed eye/cheek profile projections remain attached and stable. Enlarged edges show ordinary antialiasing rather than a target-style colored halo. No material new black patch, exposed hollow cuff, detached part, screen-edge clipping or directional ground shadow was found.

All192 frames across all16 clip/facing combinations were checked. Body/head bob, work arm motion, hold and load dish travel remain continuous. The new wrap, cuffs, collar, apron and back bow follow the rig without tearing, flickering, popping topology or obvious texture swimming. Idle/work/hold loop smoothly; all4 load clips stop after the intended final frame.

Feet retain stable grounded placement, hands remain connected to cuffs, and the knife grip/work silhouette remains attached. The original camera-facing salmon insert follows its original hold/load attachment and depth behavior without new tunneling or phase discontinuity. N hides the front-held food behind the character consistently with source facing/occlusion. Technical surface comparisons support the visible original contact relationships; the salmon is explicitly retained2D, not called rebuilt3D.

Small collar/tie and cheek facets remain more stylized and compact than the very smooth target. They are stable, readable and compatible with the warm cartoon finish.
The apron has a restrained pocket/strap/waist/back-bow construction without target microstitching. Exact decorative counts and texture grain are not required.
The source salmon is still the exact packed2D insert with original attachment/depth drivers; its camera-facing presentation is a disclosed source contract, not an asserted native3D food redesign.
